criteria.requirement: The second value conflicts and raises ValueDuplicationError; putall rolls the mapping back to a:1,b:2. Both input yields and their event log remain consumed. Plan to materialize/validate finite input once, preserve a conflict report, stage a separate working map and publish only success. Mapping rollback cannot undo an external log, generator or database operation; define those boundaries separately.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
